title: Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue 2027: National Dialogue (includes Hack for Social Cause)
description: The national round of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports youth festival. Its six tracks include Hack for Social Cause, a technology hackathon for social problems. Entry is through the MY Bharat portal stages (district and state rounds run in Nov-Dec 2026).
organiser_name: MY Bharat, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports
eligibility: Age 15-29. Register on the MY Bharat portal; selection is staged.

title: Smart India Hackathon 2026: Grand Finale
description: India's largest student hackathon (Ministry of Education Innovation Cell and AICTE). The 36-hour Grand Finale is held at nodal centres across India in December 2026. Only teams nominated through their college SPOC take part.
organiser_name: Ministry of Education Innovation Cell & AICTE
venue: Nodal centres across India (assigned to finalists)
eligibility: Teams of 6 from the same institution, nominated by the college SPOC.

title: HackVerse: The Intercollegiate Challenge (IEEE)
description: A two-day intercollegiate hackathon by an IEEE student branch, bringing students from different colleges to compete, collaborate and build impactful solutions, with mentorship.
organiser_name: IEEE student branch, RNS Institute of Technology
eligibility: Students from any institution. Check the page for team rules and fees.

title: Auroville Marathon 2027
description: A non-commercial "run for the joy of running" through Auroville with 10 km, half-marathon and full-marathon distances. Every finisher is treated as a winner. Registration is online only and opens on 14 Nov 2026; bib collection is on 13 Feb.
organiser_name: Auroville Runners with the Auroville community
eligibility: Check the minimum age for each distance on the official site.

title: International Yoga Festival, Puducherry (32nd edition)
description: Held every year by the Puducherry Tourism Department with talks, workshops, yogasana competitions and cultural programmes. It has run on 4-7 January each year since 1993. The 2027 dates are not announced yet.
organiser_name: Department of Tourism, Government of Puducherry
date_label: Usually 4-7 Jan (2027 dates to be confirmed)
eligibility: Open to the public; registration is online or by form (see the official page).

title: Serendipity Arts Festival, Panaji
description: A large December arts festival across heritage buildings and riverfront spaces in Panaji: visual arts, crafts, theatre, music, dance, photography and programming for children. Dates for the 2026 edition are not published yet.
eligibility: Open to all; check the official site for programme and any registration.

title: Madras Music Season: Music Academy annual concerts
description: Chennai's December Carnatic music season. The Music Academy's annual conference and concerts ran from 15 Dec 2025 to 1 Jan 2026 last year; the 2026-27 schedule is not published yet.
date_label: Mid-Dec 2026 to early Jan 2027 (dates to be confirmed)
eligibility: Ticketed concerts; see the Academy's site for sales and student options.

title: Indian Dance Festival, Mamallapuram
description: A month-long festival of classical and folk dance staged against the Shore Temple at Mamallapuram, organised by Tamil Nadu Tourism. Last year it ran from 21 Dec to 19 Jan; the 2026-27 dates are announced each year.
organiser_name: Department of Tourism, Government of Tamil Nadu
date_label: Late Dec 2026 to mid/late Jan 2027 (dates to be confirmed)
eligibility: Open to visitors; check the official page for timings and entry details.

title: Residential volunteering at Sadhana Forest, Auroville
description: Year-round seva (selfless service) planting, mulching and watering trees and working on water conservation in a reforestation community. Volunteers commit to about 35 hours of seva a week. The community is vegan and substance-free for everyone, volunteers included.
recurrence_text: Ongoing: apply on the volunteer page
eligibility: Read the volunteer expectations on the official page before applying.

title: Volunteer with Auroville Village Action Group (AVAG)
description: AVAG welcomes volunteers with skills such as fundraising, content writing, audio-visual communication, monitoring and evaluation, social research, marketing and training. A minimum commitment of 3 months is required. Apply by email as described on the page.
eligibility: Skills-based volunteers; see the page for how to apply.

title: FOSS United Pondicherry chapter
description: The Pondicherry chapter of FOSS United, a community for free and open source software. Established in January 2025; follow the chapter page for meetups and volunteer roles.
recurrence_text: Follow the chapter page for dates
eligibility: Open to anyone interested in open source.

title: Robin Hood Army: Student Community Volunteer Drives
description: A volunteer-driven, zero-funds movement by students and young professionals across India who distribute surplus food to people in need and run the Robin Hood Academy to teach children.
venue: Local chapter drives across Indian cities
eligibility: Open to all students and volunteers. Join via the official chapter signup.

title: Khelo India Campus Sports & Athletics Club
description: National initiative by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to foster grassroots sports culture, university competitions, and fitness tracking across colleges in India.
eligibility: College students enrolled in higher educational institutions.
